title: GameMode
description: PublicGame.mode: a These Campaign Scenario (the 'these' package). This project's `These a b` values encode via sibling keys in a single JSON object -- verified empirically against this exact dependency pin (This a -> {"This":a}; That b -> {"That":b}; These a b -> {"This":a,"That":b}) -- never a wrapping "These" key. Fresh standalone play (this contract slice's fixture) is always the That-only branch; This-only (between-scenario campaign screens) and the This+That running-campaign-scenario branch are real, reachable states but are not exercised by this fixture, so the Campaign payload stays broad here pending a dedicated campaign contract slice.

oneOf.description: This-only: a Campaign snapshot with no active scenario (a between-scenario campaign screen).
That-only: a standalone scenario with no enclosing campaign.
This+That (production's `These` constructor): both an active Campaign and its currently running Scenario, encoded as sibling 'This'/'That' keys in the same object -- never a wrapping 'These' key.

campaign.description: A Campaign snapshot. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

actStack.description: The act deck, grouped by [deckIndex, [cards]]. Broad card union, out of scope for this contract slice.

additionalReferences.description: Additional scenario reference card ids in play. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

agendaStack.description: The agenda deck, grouped by [deckIndex, [cards]]. Broad card union, out of scope for this contract slice.

campaignStep.description: The active CampaignStep, when this scenario is running as part of a campaign. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

counts.description: Free-form scenario counters. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

decksLayout.description: The act/agenda deck row layout, e.g. ["agenda1 act1"].

defeatedEnemies.description: Defeated-enemy bookkeeping, keyed by card code. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

discard.description: The encounter discard pile. Broad card union, out of scope for this contract slice.

encounterDeck.description: The encounter deck. Broad card union, out of scope for this contract slice.

grid.description: The optional grid-based board layout. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

locationLayout.description: The scenario's fixed grid-topology reference art, one string per row (e.g. "   .   attic   .     ").

noRemainingInvestigatorsHandler.description: The Target to notify when no investigators remain. Broad tagged union beyond its tag, out of scope for this contract slice.

options.description: Scenario-specific options selected at creation. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

playerDecks.description: Per-player deck bookkeeping, keyed by player id. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

search.description: In-progress card-search state, if any. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

setAsideCards.description: Cards set aside during setup, not yet placed or drawn. Broad card union, out of scope for this contract slice.

standaloneCampaignLog.description: The (empty, for a fresh standalone scenario) campaign log this scenario reads and writes.

tokens.description: Tokens placed directly on the scenario reference card. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

turn.description: ScenarioAttrs.scenarioTurn (Arkham/Scenario/Types.hs). Initializes at 0 before the scenario's first turn begins.

xpBreakdown.description: Experience-point breakdown shown at scenario resolution. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.
